scenario: The ego vehicle turns left at a 4-way intersection while an adversarial vehicle turns right from the opposite direction.

ego.behavior: The car turns left at the intersection and proceeds into the opposite road.

adversarials.behavior: The car turns right at the intersection and proceeds into the same road as the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: Both vehicles start on opposite approaches of a 4-way intersection, positioned to enter the same destination road: the ego on the south approach turning left, and the adversarial on the north approach turning right.
requirements_and_restrictions: Initial positions are defined at set distances from the intersection center, and the scenario terminates once both vehicles have cleared the intersection and traveled a specified distance.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the blue car from first-person perspective; pink car is adversarial. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial car. 3. Chronology: initial both approach intersection from opposite directions; midpoint both enter intersection turning; ending both exit into same road. 4. Evidence: blue car's left-turn arrow and pink car's right-turn arrow indicate converging paths to shared destination road.
